'''Piotr Jerzy Pankanin''' (16 May 1948 – 16 November 2022) was a Polish chemist and politician. A member of [[Solidarity (Polish trade union)|Solidarity]] and later the [[Labour Union (Poland)|Labour Union]], he served in the [[Senate of Poland|Senate]] from 1991 to 1993 and the [[Sejm]] from 1993 to 1997.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/ArchAll2.nsf/2RP/282|title=Piotr Pankanin|work=Sejm|language=Polish}}</ref>

Pankanin died on 16 November 2022, at the age of 74.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=16 November 2022|title=Zmarł Piotr Pankanin: były poseł, senator, wiceprezydent Bydgoszczy, ale i radiowiec|trans-title= |url=https://www.radiopik.pl/3,105197,zmarl-piotr-pankanin-byly-posel-senator-wiceprez|language=Polish|work=Polskie Radio Pomorza i Kujaw|location= |access-date=18 November 2022}}</ref>
